title.orig: An Act Declaring June Nineteen of Every Year As A Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Surigao Del Norte, To Be Known As "Adlaw Nan Surigao Del Norte"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7553_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: June Nineteen of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Surigao del Norte, to be known as "Adlaw Nan Surigao Del Norte."
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following its publication in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation in the country.
